# FIX-ORI-SUITE-2: Repair the foreign suite drifts behind the aggregate's residual failures

## What this does

Repairs the foreign test-suite failures that keep the aggregate `pnpm test` red after the seven-suite repair — each planner-verified STANDALONE on the recorded candidate (`2f15ba41`, byte-identical to trunk `dbf3c0af` for every suite file this task may touch) — and honestly routes the two reported failures that are NOT test drift. Four foreign suites carry real test-side drift or runtime-class damage; the other two of the six reported failures are owner-routed or environmental, and this task does NOT charter a mask for either.

The planner-verified per-suite ledger (every observation below was reproduced by the planner on `2f15ba41` via the exact per-suite selectors preserved in this charter):

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts` (ORI-AST-001) — 2 of 4 tokens verified failing FAST (`ORI-AST-001-collection-schema` and `ORI-AST-001-publication-contract` each die at the first scratch build: `'valid build exits 0': expected 1 to be +0` inside ~1.5 s; `ORI-AST-001-mdx-code-copy` was reported failing in the same window and needs the same fixture repair plus a free 4321 for Part A; `ORI-AST-001-prose-navigation` passes). ROOT CAUSE verified by scratch reproduction: `makeScratch()` (docs-collection.test.ts:92-108) mirrors only the root `package.json` plus `apps/docs/**`, but the landed app now references two more repo-root trees — `apps/docs/src/components/TokenTable.astro:5` imports `../../../../scripts/docs-data/token-map` (landed by ORI-AST-003), and the quickstart page's render-time source read opens `packages/docs-snippets/shared/quickstart-messages.ts` (the ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1 tutorial designation), so every scratch build dies `UNRESOLVED_IMPORT` (scripts absent) and then `ENOENT ... quickstart-messages.ts` (render-time). VERIFIED REPAIR: with exactly `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` mirrored into the scratch, the identical scratch `astro build` exits 0 with `Complete!` and emits `dist/docs/collection-reference/index.html`. The repair is the fixture: extend `makeScratch()` to mirror the two root trees, exactly the existing root-`package.json` precedent at docs-collection.test.ts:95.
2. `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts` (FUSE-05) — the full file verified standalone: 1 failed / 3 passed (~11 min; both 900-second build drills pass). The sole failure is `copies public r generated-only and byte-identical` at :323 — `git ls-files apps/docs/public` must be empty, but ORI-VIS-001 (`1c732dc1`) landed five AUTHORED font files under `apps/docs/public/fonts/` (`OFL.txt`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin.woff2`). The 57-per-engine counts, the byte-identity mirror, and every check-ignore assertion above :323 pass unchanged. Repair: scope the tracked-files assertion to the GENERATED subtree — `git ls-files apps/docs/public/r` must be empty — with a supersede comment naming `1c732dc1`; the authored fonts stay tracked by design.
3. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts` (FLOW-DOCS-02) — token `AC-4 pins the hook contract, compiles both graphs and tears down owned children` verified failing standalone at :631 — `expect(hookSource).toContain("from 'expo/fetch'")` is stale since FIX-ORI-AI-001-1 (`755edeae`) moved the hook to the lazy form `const { fetch: expoFetch } = await import('expo/fetch')` at `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts:46` (the lazy import lets the module load outside Metro). Everything else in the token verified current on the candidate: both `tsc --noEmit` compiles exit 0 (`apps/example/server/tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.live-chat.json`), all four PINS read back exactly (`ai@7.0.89`, `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.92`, `@ai-sdk/openai@4.0.66`, `zod@4.6.1`), and every other hook literal is present (`DefaultChatTransport`, `throttle: 50`, `messages: []` at use-live-chat.ts:203, `clearError();` before `regenerate();` at :20-21). Repair: the one literal takes the current lazy form; every neighboring oracle stays byte-effective.
4. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts` (ORI-RN-005) — the two marathon tokens (`ORI-RN-005-abort-error-retry` :201, `ORI-RN-005-fail-closed-cleanup` :270, both `timeout: 75 * 60_000`) failed inside the 16-hour aggregate. The recorded run manifests (`.tmp/ORI-RN-005/{abort-error-retry,fail-closed-cleanup}/manifest.json`) show CONCLUDED runs (`teardown.json` written with fresh `finished_at` — 2026-09-26T05:30:49Z and 09:35:21Z) whose legs failed on runtime observations, not assertion drift: iOS `seed turn ended as no terminal record`, Android `"Live chat" never appeared (60s)`, web `growthSamples: []`. The 5-entry source manifest (`nativewind-live-source-manifest.json`) verified hash-current against every mapped source — no drift. RUNTIME CLASS: this task stands both tokens back up STANDALONE in a reserved-device quiet window (real iOS simulator, Android emulator, web export, owned backend, official OpenAI Responses endpoint), and may adjust the per-token budget ONLY on observed timeout-mechanism evidence with the kill-retry arithmetic recorded (`runDriverWithKillRetry` :93-111 doubles any externally-killed run — a 30-35 min full run retried once exceeds nothing at 75 min, but a fail-closed case-3 full run plus a retried leg can; the math must be in the comment and the handoff). A leg failure that reproduces standalone for a PRODUCT reason is a blocked report owner-routed to the ORI-RN-005 surface — never a mask, never a skip, never a lowered assertion.

Owner-routed — NOT chartered for repair: `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/ci-chain-order.test.ts` (FLOW-DELIV-01). Planner-verified: its FUSE-12 lane AC-1 (the `... ships 112 dist JSONs` token — the 114 current-literal already landed at :246-248 with 57-per-engine at :255) PASSES standalone, and AC-2 (the ci.yml parse proof) PASSES standalone. The suite's only failing token is `FLOW-DELIV-01-ci-chain-order` (:66), which runs the root `pnpm e2e:docs` twice — the full Playwright lane — whose only currently-failing spec token is `recovery-presentation.spec.ts` ac-5 (:745-806): the public-origin prerequisite that hard-throws `PUBLIC PREREQUISITE unmet` until ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the reviewed candidate at the apex (planner probe 2026-09-26: `https://rnraielements.com/<unknown-path>` answers HTTP 404 with an EMPTY body — no branded recovery surface). No test edit can make that token pass before deployment; the file stays outside this task's boundary. The stale `'[data-search-slot] button'` constant at `recovery-presentation.spec.ts:52` is LATENT only — its two uses (:522, :611) are `toBeHidden()` assertions, which are strict-mode-exempt and pass with the close button present — so no repair is chartered there either; report-only.

Environmental — NOT chartered as an assertion change: `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/contributing-content.test.ts` (ORI-CONT-006). Planner-verified 4/4 PASS standalone on the candidate (the `ORI-CONT-006-real-docs-checks` token runs the real build / check:snippets / check:links chain green). Its aggregate failure was the end-of-run tmpdir-reaper cascade that killed 87 collections (~/.cache/agent-scratch vite transform scratch reaped ~16 h in). The remedy this task owns is RUN HYGIENE for the one aggregate rerun: a stable TMPDIR outside the agent-session scratch, recorded in run.json — no edit to the suite.

AGGREGATE REALITY this charter encodes honestly: the vitest aggregate includes ci-chain-order's full-e2e token, so `pnpm test` cannot exit 0 before ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the candidate at the public origin. AC-3 therefore defines an attributed-residual gate: the aggregate is run ONCE (never harness-spawned), its complete failing inventory is recorded, and every suite outside a named residual closure must be green in-aggregate. Nothing residual is silent.

## Why

The in-flight seven-suite repair landed all seven chartered repairs and proved them green in isolation, then blocked honestly on its aggregate clause: six foreign suites fail on the candidate through no fault of those repairs (cycle-1 blocked report, recorded 2026-09-26; wave-21 decision). This task owns the four of those six that are test-side drift or runtime-class damage — each planner-verified standalone in this planning pass, with the two non-drift failures routed to their owners instead of masked — so the aggregate's residual failure set collapses to exactly the deployment-gated closure that ORI-DEP-002/003 own. The owning tasks of the drifted suites (ORI-AST-001, FUSE-05/FLOW-DELIV-01, ORI-AI-001, ORI-RN-005, ORI-CONT-006) are all completed; the drift is collateral of landed, reviewed sprint-05 work (ORI-AST-003's token-map import, ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1's render-time snippet read, ORI-VIS-001's authored fonts, FIX-ORI-AI-001-1's lazy expo/fetch import) and of the 16-hour serialized aggregate environment.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
```

The first command is the exact selector: the task-owned proof harness spawns each named per-suite selector (the three drifted vitest suites, the live-example-api AC-4 token, and the two NativeWind marathon tokens with per-child timeouts sized to their real envelopes), asserts exit 0 for each, runs `pnpm typecheck` and the scoped Biome command, and asserts the tracked-file diff boundary — recording RED (the planner-verified standalone failures above, bound to the pre-change candidate SHA) and GREEN (per-selector exit 0) in `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/`. `pnpm test` (the aggregate vitest run), `pnpm typecheck`, and the scoped Biome command are preserved GREEN commands the implementer runs and records in `run.json`; the harness never spawns the aggregate (a vitest child spawning the vitest aggregate would re-run every drill and the harness — unbounded recursion).

## Scope

Own exactly the four named test files, the task-owned proof harness, drill-emitted evidence writes, and bounded `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/` evidence. Zero product-source changes: the docs-collection fixture repair COPIES `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` into its owned scratch and never edits the originals; `apps/**`, `packages/**`, and `scripts/**` on the candidate stay byte-unchanged. The two non-drift failures stay outside the boundary: ci-chain-order.test.ts and recovery-presentation.spec.ts are owner-routed to ORI-DEP-002/003 (report-only), and contributing-content.test.ts is verified green standalone (run-hygiene only, no edit).

# Sprint 05: orient-search

**Status:** in_progress  
**Sequence:** 5  
**Timeline:** Phase 2

## Overview

Give a first-time integrator a complete orientation path: Introduction, one engine decision, registry-specific installation and CLI guidance, Theming and Dark mode, one seed-data Quickstart, and a handoff to a real AI SDK v7 example. Connect that content to persistent engine tabs, live theme values, built-site search, registry destinations, and useful missing-page recovery.

Absorb the smallest real prerequisites that make those paths executable: the published PromptInput import graph, both clean Expo consumers, a substantive ownership explanation, actual 404 recovery, the real example API and native composition, canonical registry hosting, and source-bound build and publication checks. This does not add another tutorial or a demonstrated use case. Sprint 06 may deepen the ownership tables; Sprint 11 may deepen resilience and accessibility; later delivery work may harden deployment and rollback.

The plan contains **36 tasks / 131 points**, compared with the roadmap sketch of approximately 12 items / 34–55 points: **76 points above its upper bound**. It retains 13 locked flows, 13 numbered gate steps, and four post-integration journey proofs. Estimates describe the approved prerequisite absorption rather than forcing the work into the sketch.

All implementation, functional RED, product verification, hosted acceptance, and deployment proof are future work. This document records a plan, not a passing gate or release.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** A stranger opening /docs/introduction over the built site's local preview can read in one pass that the library provides universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native, that it is distributed as a copy-paste registry, and that it is not an npm package.

**Entrypoint:** docs site local preview — built dist served by astro preview (http://localhost:4321) or the pnpm e2e:docs webServer; route /docs/introduction

**Before:** The source snapshot at the planned source SHA already contains Theming and shared layout, header, table, and tab controls. Introduction, Installation, CLI, Dark mode, Quickstart, the ownership-boundary route, and a custom 404 route are absent in that inspected snapshot. Existing Theming content still needs engine-correct claims and the real paired TokenTable. These are planning observations from the source, not current browser results. Each owner must observe the actual functional failure before implementation; the stale roadmap claim that all of these controls are absent is not a RED oracle.

**Success state:** A visitor reads useful, source-backed bodies instead of empty shells, chooses the correct engine once, follows literal registry commands, reads the same information without JavaScript, sees live theme changes without a flash, and reaches real content through keyboard search or missing-page recovery. The single Quickstart reaches a visible seed-data screen and then a separately verified real-provider example. Acceptance also requires the discriminating build checks and fresh native, provider, public-registry, and hosted evidence specified below.

**Demonstrates:** UC-DOCS-01, UC-DOCS-02, UC-SHELL-02, UC-SHELL-01 (TokenTable half), UC-SHELL-03 (prose-persistence half)

**Fixed carryover:** UC-GEND-07 AC-2; TR-12 (full); CAP-DOCS-01 snippet/link build integration. Boundary, recovery, API, and publication work support this projection; they do not expand the demonstrated-use-case list.

# FIX-ORI-SUITE-2: Repair the foreign suite drifts behind the aggregate's residual failures

## What this does

Repairs the foreign test-suite failures that keep the aggregate `pnpm test` red after the seven-suite repair — each planner-verified STANDALONE on the recorded candidate (`2f15ba41`, byte-identical to trunk `dbf3c0af` for every suite file this task may touch) — and honestly routes the two reported failures that are NOT test drift. Four foreign suites carry real test-side drift or runtime-class damage; the other two of the six reported failures are owner-routed or environmental, and this task does NOT charter a mask for either.

The planner-verified per-suite ledger (every observation below was reproduced by the planner on `2f15ba41` via the exact per-suite selectors preserved in this charter):

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts` (ORI-AST-001) — 2 of 4 tokens verified failing FAST (`ORI-AST-001-collection-schema` and `ORI-AST-001-publication-contract` each die at the first scratch build: `'valid build exits 0': expected 1 to be +0` inside ~1.5 s; `ORI-AST-001-mdx-code-copy` was reported failing in the same window and needs the same fixture repair plus a free 4321 for Part A; `ORI-AST-001-prose-navigation` passes). ROOT CAUSE verified by scratch reproduction: `makeScratch()` (docs-collection.test.ts:92-108) mirrors only the root `package.json` plus `apps/docs/**`, but the landed app now references two more repo-root trees — `apps/docs/src/components/TokenTable.astro:5` imports `../../../../scripts/docs-data/token-map` (landed by ORI-AST-003), and the quickstart page's render-time source read opens `packages/docs-snippets/shared/quickstart-messages.ts` (the ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1 tutorial designation), so every scratch build dies `UNRESOLVED_IMPORT` (scripts absent) and then `ENOENT ... quickstart-messages.ts` (render-time). VERIFIED REPAIR: with exactly `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` mirrored into the scratch, the identical scratch `astro build` exits 0 with `Complete!` and emits `dist/docs/collection-reference/index.html`. The repair is the fixture: extend `makeScratch()` to mirror the two root trees, exactly the existing root-`package.json` precedent at docs-collection.test.ts:95.
2. `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts` (FUSE-05) — the full file verified standalone: 1 failed / 3 passed (~11 min; both 900-second build drills pass). The sole failure is `copies public r generated-only and byte-identical` at :323 — `git ls-files apps/docs/public` must be empty, but ORI-VIS-001 (`1c732dc1`) landed five AUTHORED font files under `apps/docs/public/fonts/` (`OFL.txt`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin.woff2`). The 57-per-engine counts, the byte-identity mirror, and every check-ignore assertion above :323 pass unchanged. Repair: scope the tracked-files assertion to the GENERATED subtree — `git ls-files apps/docs/public/r` must be empty — with a supersede comment naming `1c732dc1`; the authored fonts stay tracked by design.
3. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts` (FLOW-DOCS-02) — token `AC-4 pins the hook contract, compiles both graphs and tears down owned children` verified failing standalone at :631 — `expect(hookSource).toContain("from 'expo/fetch'")` is stale since FIX-ORI-AI-001-1 (`755edeae`) moved the hook to the lazy form `const { fetch: expoFetch } = await import('expo/fetch')` at `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts:46` (the lazy import lets the module load outside Metro). Everything else in the token verified current on the candidate: both `tsc --noEmit` compiles exit 0 (`apps/example/server/tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.live-chat.json`), all four PINS read back exactly (`ai@7.0.89`, `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.92`, `@ai-sdk/openai@4.0.66`, `zod@4.6.1`), and every other hook literal is present (`DefaultChatTransport`, `throttle: 50`, `messages: []` at use-live-chat.ts:203, `clearError();` before `regenerate();` at :20-21). Repair: the one literal takes the current lazy form; every neighboring oracle stays byte-effective.
4. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts` (ORI-RN-005) — the two marathon tokens (`ORI-RN-005-abort-error-retry` :201, `ORI-RN-005-fail-closed-cleanup` :270, both `timeout: 75 * 60_000`) failed inside the 16-hour aggregate. The recorded run manifests (`.tmp/ORI-RN-005/{abort-error-retry,fail-closed-cleanup}/manifest.json`) show CONCLUDED runs (`teardown.json` written with fresh `finished_at` — 2026-09-26T05:30:49Z and 09:35:21Z) whose legs failed on runtime observations, not assertion drift: iOS `seed turn ended as no terminal record`, Android `"Live chat" never appeared (60s)`, web `growthSamples: []`. The 5-entry source manifest (`nativewind-live-source-manifest.json`) verified hash-current against every mapped source — no drift. RUNTIME CLASS: this task stands both tokens back up STANDALONE in a reserved-device quiet window (real iOS simulator, Android emulator, web export, owned backend, official OpenAI Responses endpoint), and may adjust the per-token budget ONLY on observed timeout-mechanism evidence with the kill-retry arithmetic recorded (`runDriverWithKillRetry` :93-111 doubles any externally-killed run — a 30-35 min full run retried once exceeds nothing at 75 min, but a fail-closed case-3 full run plus a retried leg can; the math must be in the comment and the handoff). A leg failure that reproduces standalone for a PRODUCT reason is a blocked report owner-routed to the ORI-RN-005 surface — never a mask, never a skip, never a lowered assertion.

Owner-routed — NOT chartered for repair: `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/ci-chain-order.test.ts` (FLOW-DELIV-01). Planner-verified: its FUSE-12 lane AC-1 (the `... ships 112 dist JSONs` token — the 114 current-literal already landed at :246-248 with 57-per-engine at :255) PASSES standalone, and AC-2 (the ci.yml parse proof) PASSES standalone. The suite's only failing token is `FLOW-DELIV-01-ci-chain-order` (:66), which runs the root `pnpm e2e:docs` twice — the full Playwright lane — whose only currently-failing spec token is `recovery-presentation.spec.ts` ac-5 (:745-806): the public-origin prerequisite that hard-throws `PUBLIC PREREQUISITE unmet` until ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the reviewed candidate at the apex (planner probe 2026-09-26: `https://rnraielements.com/<unknown-path>` answers HTTP 404 with an EMPTY body — no branded recovery surface). No test edit can make that token pass before deployment; the file stays outside this task's boundary. The stale `'[data-search-slot] button'` constant at `recovery-presentation.spec.ts:52` is LATENT only — its two uses (:522, :611) are `toBeHidden()` assertions, which are strict-mode-exempt and pass with the close button present — so no repair is chartered there either; report-only.

Environmental — NOT chartered as an assertion change: `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/contributing-content.test.ts` (ORI-CONT-006). Planner-verified 4/4 PASS standalone on the candidate (the `ORI-CONT-006-real-docs-checks` token runs the real build / check:snippets / check:links chain green). Its aggregate failure was the end-of-run tmpdir-reaper cascade that killed 87 collections (~/.cache/agent-scratch vite transform scratch reaped ~16 h in). The remedy this task owns is RUN HYGIENE for the one aggregate rerun: a stable TMPDIR outside the agent-session scratch, recorded in run.json — no edit to the suite.

AGGREGATE REALITY this charter encodes honestly: the vitest aggregate includes ci-chain-order's full-e2e token, so `pnpm test` cannot exit 0 before ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the candidate at the public origin. AC-3 therefore defines an attributed-residual gate: the aggregate is run ONCE (never harness-spawned), its complete failing inventory is recorded, and every suite outside a named residual closure must be green in-aggregate. Nothing residual is silent.

## Why

The in-flight seven-suite repair landed all seven chartered repairs and proved them green in isolation, then blocked honestly on its aggregate clause: six foreign suites fail on the candidate through no fault of those repairs (cycle-1 blocked report, recorded 2026-09-26; wave-21 decision). This task owns the four of those six that are test-side drift or runtime-class damage — each planner-verified standalone in this planning pass, with the two non-drift failures routed to their owners instead of masked — so the aggregate's residual failure set collapses to exactly the deployment-gated closure that ORI-DEP-002/003 own. The owning tasks of the drifted suites (ORI-AST-001, FUSE-05/FLOW-DELIV-01, ORI-AI-001, ORI-RN-005, ORI-CONT-006) are all completed; the drift is collateral of landed, reviewed sprint-05 work (ORI-AST-003's token-map import, ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1's render-time snippet read, ORI-VIS-001's authored fonts, FIX-ORI-AI-001-1's lazy expo/fetch import) and of the 16-hour serialized aggregate environment.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
```

The first command is the exact selector: the task-owned proof harness spawns each named per-suite selector (the three drifted vitest suites, the live-example-api AC-4 token, and the two NativeWind marathon tokens with per-child timeouts sized to their real envelopes), asserts exit 0 for each, runs `pnpm typecheck` and the scoped Biome command, and asserts the tracked-file diff boundary — recording RED (the planner-verified standalone failures above, bound to the pre-change candidate SHA) and GREEN (per-selector exit 0) in `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/`. `pnpm test` (the aggregate vitest run), `pnpm typecheck`, and the scoped Biome command are preserved GREEN commands the implementer runs and records in `run.json`; the harness never spawns the aggregate (a vitest child spawning the vitest aggregate would re-run every drill and the harness — unbounded recursion).

## Scope

Own exactly the four named test files, the task-owned proof harness, drill-emitted evidence writes, and bounded `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/` evidence. Zero product-source changes: the docs-collection fixture repair COPIES `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` into its owned scratch and never edits the originals; `apps/**`, `packages/**`, and `scripts/**` on the candidate stay byte-unchanged. The two non-drift failures stay outside the boundary: ci-chain-order.test.ts and recovery-presentation.spec.ts are owner-routed to ORI-DEP-002/003 (report-only), and contributing-content.test.ts is verified green standalone (run-hygiene only, no edit).

# Sprint 05: orient-search

**Status:** in_progress  
**Sequence:** 5  
**Timeline:** Phase 2

## Overview

Give a first-time integrator a complete orientation path: Introduction, one engine decision, registry-specific installation and CLI guidance, Theming and Dark mode, one seed-data Quickstart, and a handoff to a real AI SDK v7 example. Connect that content to persistent engine tabs, live theme values, built-site search, registry destinations, and useful missing-page recovery.

Absorb the smallest real prerequisites that make those paths executable: the published PromptInput import graph, both clean Expo consumers, a substantive ownership explanation, actual 404 recovery, the real example API and native composition, canonical registry hosting, and source-bound build and publication checks. This does not add another tutorial or a demonstrated use case. Sprint 06 may deepen the ownership tables; Sprint 11 may deepen resilience and accessibility; later delivery work may harden deployment and rollback.

The plan contains **36 tasks / 131 points**, compared with the roadmap sketch of approximately 12 items / 34–55 points: **76 points above its upper bound**. It retains 13 locked flows, 13 numbered gate steps, and four post-integration journey proofs. Estimates describe the approved prerequisite absorption rather than forcing the work into the sketch.

All implementation, functional RED, product verification, hosted acceptance, and deployment proof are future work. This document records a plan, not a passing gate or release.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** A stranger opening /docs/introduction over the built site's local preview can read in one pass that the library provides universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native, that it is distributed as a copy-paste registry, and that it is not an npm package.

**Entrypoint:** docs site local preview — built dist served by astro preview (http://localhost:4321) or the pnpm e2e:docs webServer; route /docs/introduction

**Before:** The source snapshot at the planned source SHA already contains Theming and shared layout, header, table, and tab controls. Introduction, Installation, CLI, Dark mode, Quickstart, the ownership-boundary route, and a custom 404 route are absent in that inspected snapshot. Existing Theming content still needs engine-correct claims and the real paired TokenTable. These are planning observations from the source, not current browser results. Each owner must observe the actual functional failure before implementation; the stale roadmap claim that all of these controls are absent is not a RED oracle.

**Success state:** A visitor reads useful, source-backed bodies instead of empty shells, chooses the correct engine once, follows literal registry commands, reads the same information without JavaScript, sees live theme changes without a flash, and reaches real content through keyboard search or missing-page recovery. The single Quickstart reaches a visible seed-data screen and then a separately verified real-provider example. Acceptance also requires the discriminating build checks and fresh native, provider, public-registry, and hosted evidence specified below.

**Demonstrates:** UC-DOCS-01, UC-DOCS-02, UC-SHELL-02, UC-SHELL-01 (TokenTable half), UC-SHELL-03 (prose-persistence half)

**Fixed carryover:** UC-GEND-07 AC-2; TR-12 (full); CAP-DOCS-01 snippet/link build integration. Boundary, recovery, API, and publication work support this projection; they do not expand the demonstrated-use-case list.

The following seven preconditions remain unresolved. Environment-variable presence, cached login state, a registered domain, local proof, or planned runner labels do not establish success. Resolve each with actual evidence before its owning task can complete; unavailable requirements must fail closed.

- **VP-AI-PACKAGES** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): Verify published metadata and actual installation of ai@7.0.89, @ai-sdk/react@4.0.92, @ai-sdk/openai@4.0.66 and zod@4.6.1 through Expo tooling. The hook/provider packages were absent locally and the proposed hook pin was not retrievable in the specialist session. Require real LanguageModelV4 compatibility and compiler proof. If the pin is unavailable or incompatible, stop for a version decision; do not silently take latest or add API compatibility shims.

- **VP-OPENAI** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): OPENAI_API_KEY presence is not provider proof. Make actual server-side requests to the fixed official OpenAI Responses endpoint using gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 and record sanitized authentication/model/quota/network outcomes. - **VP-NATIVE** (`requires_runtime_setup`): Reserve explicit RNR_S05_IOS_UDID and RNR_S05_ANDROID_SERIAL. Boot the selected available Android AVD; adb had no running target in the specialist observations. Verify compatible Expo Go and real native automation. Preserve unrelated booted simulators. Use separate engine consumers/caches and native worktree-local build outputs. Verify actual expo/fetch streaming, structuredClone and text-encoding globals on each running target; missing required runtime support blocks the owning native task.

- **VP-CANONICAL-AUTHORITY** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): Verify actual owning Cloudflare account, active zone, Worker identity, effective permissions, DNS/custom-domain/routes and absence of conflicts or another deployment owner. Cached local OAuth and registration do not prove authority. Use cached OAuth without reading or copying its token; expired/insufficient access requires the account owner's normal restoration.

- **VP-PUBLIC-DNS-TLS** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): rnraielements.com was registered but not resolving in parent preflight. Wait for actual activation, ordinary public DNS and trusted HTTPS serving the corrected real registry. Do not use hosts-file overrides, local URL rewrites, arbitrary preview hosts or disabled certificate validation to satisfy literal CLI installs.

- **VP-HOSTED-RUNNER** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): Provision and verify an eligible exclusive clean/ephemeral macOS ARM64 native runner, its real device/browser/toolchain capabilities and resource reservations. The rnr-s05-native label is proposed, not observed registered. No personal workstation credential cache enters candidate jobs. Without that runner, hosted full native/provider acceptance remains blocked; local proof cannot impersonate GitHub checks.

- **VP-GITHUB-PROTECTION** (`unverified_external_prerequisite`): Verify actual required-check names, workflow availability, same-repository dispatch identity, candidate SHA/event SHA equality, environment protection support, independent approval preventing self-approval, runner-group restrictions and artifact access. Validate action full-SHA provenance before use. Fork/unreviewed code must not receive provider credentials or execute on the protected native runner.

### Execution safeguards

Reserve the real backend, Metro, Web, browser, and native resources. Require the candidate's owned preview on port 4321; identify existing listeners and refuse an unowned conflict. Do not kill unrelated processes or fall back to another origin to satisfy the locked gate. Keep the selected provider secret on the trusted server side, never in Metro, installed consumers, browser code, EXPO_PUBLIC values, arguments, or artifacts.

Use the approved ordered registry/gallery/docs-data/snippet/Astro/Pagefind/link build and current-invocation proof matrix. The initial canonical registry must exist before literal CLI installation. Public registry hashes must match the final accepted candidate; a mismatch requires renewed review and fresh proof. Upload the accepted candidate once, verify its nonpromoting real Cloudflare version, and then promote that exact version at the apex. The first domain attachment uses the approved attended Wrangler flow; do not overwrite conflicting ownership automatically.

Inspect native screenshots before making visual claims. No stub, mocked core dependency, placeholder page, canned provider reply, skipped target, or stale manifest satisfies this plan.

# FIX-ORI-SUITE-2: Repair the foreign suite drifts behind the aggregate's residual failures

## What this does

Repairs the foreign test-suite failures that keep the aggregate `pnpm test` red after the seven-suite repair — each planner-verified STANDALONE on the recorded candidate (`2f15ba41`, byte-identical to trunk `dbf3c0af` for every suite file this task may touch) — and honestly routes the two reported failures that are NOT test drift. Four foreign suites carry real test-side drift or runtime-class damage; the other two of the six reported failures are owner-routed or environmental, and this task does NOT charter a mask for either.

The planner-verified per-suite ledger (every observation below was reproduced by the planner on `2f15ba41` via the exact per-suite selectors preserved in this charter):

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts` (ORI-AST-001) — 2 of 4 tokens verified failing FAST (`ORI-AST-001-collection-schema` and `ORI-AST-001-publication-contract` each die at the first scratch build: `'valid build exits 0': expected 1 to be +0` inside ~1.5 s; `ORI-AST-001-mdx-code-copy` was reported failing in the same window and needs the same fixture repair plus a free 4321 for Part A; `ORI-AST-001-prose-navigation` passes). ROOT CAUSE verified by scratch reproduction: `makeScratch()` (docs-collection.test.ts:92-108) mirrors only the root `package.json` plus `apps/docs/**`, but the landed app now references two more repo-root trees — `apps/docs/src/components/TokenTable.astro:5` imports `../../../../scripts/docs-data/token-map` (landed by ORI-AST-003), and the quickstart page's render-time source read opens `packages/docs-snippets/shared/quickstart-messages.ts` (the ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1 tutorial designation), so every scratch build dies `UNRESOLVED_IMPORT` (scripts absent) and then `ENOENT ... quickstart-messages.ts` (render-time). VERIFIED REPAIR: with exactly `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` mirrored into the scratch, the identical scratch `astro build` exits 0 with `Complete!` and emits `dist/docs/collection-reference/index.html`. The repair is the fixture: extend `makeScratch()` to mirror the two root trees, exactly the existing root-`package.json` precedent at docs-collection.test.ts:95.
2. `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts` (FUSE-05) — the full file verified standalone: 1 failed / 3 passed (~11 min; both 900-second build drills pass). The sole failure is `copies public r generated-only and byte-identical` at :323 — `git ls-files apps/docs/public` must be empty, but ORI-VIS-001 (`1c732dc1`) landed five AUTHORED font files under `apps/docs/public/fonts/` (`OFL.txt`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin.woff2`). The 57-per-engine counts, the byte-identity mirror, and every check-ignore assertion above :323 pass unchanged. Repair: scope the tracked-files assertion to the GENERATED subtree — `git ls-files apps/docs/public/r` must be empty — with a supersede comment naming `1c732dc1`; the authored fonts stay tracked by design.
3. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts` (FLOW-DOCS-02) — token `AC-4 pins the hook contract, compiles both graphs and tears down owned children` verified failing standalone at :631 — `expect(hookSource).toContain("from 'expo/fetch'")` is stale since FIX-ORI-AI-001-1 (`755edeae`) moved the hook to the lazy form `const { fetch: expoFetch } = await import('expo/fetch')` at `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts:46` (the lazy import lets the module load outside Metro). Everything else in the token verified current on the candidate: both `tsc --noEmit` compiles exit 0 (`apps/example/server/tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.live-chat.json`), all four PINS read back exactly (`ai@7.0.89`, `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.92`, `@ai-sdk/openai@4.0.66`, `zod@4.6.1`), and every other hook literal is present (`DefaultChatTransport`, `throttle: 50`, `messages: []` at use-live-chat.ts:203, `clearError();` before `regenerate();` at :20-21). Repair: the one literal takes the current lazy form; every neighboring oracle stays byte-effective.
4. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts` (ORI-RN-005) — the two marathon tokens (`ORI-RN-005-abort-error-retry` :201, `ORI-RN-005-fail-closed-cleanup` :270, both `timeout: 75 * 60_000`) failed inside the 16-hour aggregate. The recorded run manifests (`.tmp/ORI-RN-005/{abort-error-retry,fail-closed-cleanup}/manifest.json`) show CONCLUDED runs (`teardown.json` written with fresh `finished_at` — 2026-09-26T05:30:49Z and 09:35:21Z) whose legs failed on runtime observations, not assertion drift: iOS `seed turn ended as no terminal record`, Android `"Live chat" never appeared (60s)`, web `growthSamples: []`. The 5-entry source manifest (`nativewind-live-source-manifest.json`) verified hash-current against every mapped source — no drift. RUNTIME CLASS: this task stands both tokens back up STANDALONE in a reserved-device quiet window (real iOS simulator, Android emulator, web export, owned backend, official OpenAI Responses endpoint), and may adjust the per-token budget ONLY on observed timeout-mechanism evidence with the kill-retry arithmetic recorded (`runDriverWithKillRetry` :93-111 doubles any externally-killed run — a 30-35 min full run retried once exceeds nothing at 75 min, but a fail-closed case-3 full run plus a retried leg can; the math must be in the comment and the handoff). A leg failure that reproduces standalone for a PRODUCT reason is a blocked report owner-routed to the ORI-RN-005 surface — never a mask, never a skip, never a lowered assertion.

Owner-routed — NOT chartered for repair: `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/ci-chain-order.test.ts` (FLOW-DELIV-01). Planner-verified: its FUSE-12 lane AC-1 (the `... ships 112 dist JSONs` token — the 114 current-literal already landed at :246-248 with 57-per-engine at :255) PASSES standalone, and AC-2 (the ci.yml parse proof) PASSES standalone. The suite's only failing token is `FLOW-DELIV-01-ci-chain-order` (:66), which runs the root `pnpm e2e:docs` twice — the full Playwright lane — whose only currently-failing spec token is `recovery-presentation.spec.ts` ac-5 (:745-806): the public-origin prerequisite that hard-throws `PUBLIC PREREQUISITE unmet` until ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the reviewed candidate at the apex (planner probe 2026-09-26: `https://rnraielements.com/<unknown-path>` answers HTTP 404 with an EMPTY body — no branded recovery surface). No test edit can make that token pass before deployment; the file stays outside this task's boundary. The stale `'[data-search-slot] button'` constant at `recovery-presentation.spec.ts:52` is LATENT only — its two uses (:522, :611) are `toBeHidden()` assertions, which are strict-mode-exempt and pass with the close button present — so no repair is chartered there either; report-only.

Environmental — NOT chartered as an assertion change: `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/contributing-content.test.ts` (ORI-CONT-006). Planner-verified 4/4 PASS standalone on the candidate (the `ORI-CONT-006-real-docs-checks` token runs the real build / check:snippets / check:links chain green). Its aggregate failure was the end-of-run tmpdir-reaper cascade that killed 87 collections (~/.cache/agent-scratch vite transform scratch reaped ~16 h in). The remedy this task owns is RUN HYGIENE for the one aggregate rerun: a stable TMPDIR outside the agent-session scratch, recorded in run.json — no edit to the suite.

AGGREGATE REALITY this charter encodes honestly: the vitest aggregate includes ci-chain-order's full-e2e token, Local `pnpm test` and `pnpm e2e:docs` do not collect ORI-VIS-005-ac-5. That check is mandatory only after publication, via `pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/sprint-05-orient-search/publication.playwright.config.ts`, and it is not this task's verify command. AC-3 therefore defines an attributed-residual gate: the aggregate is run ONCE (never harness-spawned), its complete failing inventory is recorded, and every suite outside a named residual closure must be green in-aggregate. Nothing residual is silent.

## Why

The in-flight seven-suite repair landed all seven chartered repairs and proved them green in isolation, then blocked honestly on its aggregate clause: six foreign suites fail on the candidate through no fault of those repairs (cycle-1 blocked report, recorded 2026-09-26; wave-21 decision). This task owns the four of those six that are test-side drift or runtime-class damage — each planner-verified standalone in this planning pass, with the two non-drift failures routed to their owners instead of masked — so the aggregate's residual failure set collapses to exactly the deployment-gated closure that ORI-DEP-002/003 own. The owning tasks of the drifted suites (ORI-AST-001, FUSE-05/FLOW-DELIV-01, ORI-AI-001, ORI-RN-005, ORI-CONT-006) are all completed; the drift is collateral of landed, reviewed sprint-05 work (ORI-AST-003's token-map import, ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1's render-time snippet read, ORI-VIS-001's authored fonts, FIX-ORI-AI-001-1's lazy expo/fetch import) and of the 16-hour serialized aggregate environment.

## How to verify

# FIX-ORI-SUITE-2: Repair the foreign suite drifts behind the aggregate's residual failures

## What this does

Repairs the foreign test-suite failures that keep the aggregate `pnpm test` red after the seven-suite repair — each planner-verified STANDALONE on the recorded candidate (`2f15ba41`, byte-identical to trunk `dbf3c0af` for every suite file this task may touch) — and honestly routes the two reported failures that are NOT test drift. Four foreign suites carry real test-side drift or runtime-class damage; the other two of the six reported failures are owner-routed or environmental, and this task does NOT charter a mask for either.

The planner-verified per-suite ledger (every observation below was reproduced by the planner on `2f15ba41` via the exact per-suite selectors preserved in this charter):

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts` (ORI-AST-001) — 2 of 4 tokens verified failing FAST (`ORI-AST-001-collection-schema` and `ORI-AST-001-publication-contract` each die at the first scratch build: `'valid build exits 0': expected 1 to be +0` inside ~1.5 s; `ORI-AST-001-mdx-code-copy` was reported failing in the same window and needs the same fixture repair plus a free 4321 for Part A; `ORI-AST-001-prose-navigation` passes). ROOT CAUSE verified by scratch reproduction: `makeScratch()` (docs-collection.test.ts:92-108) mirrors only the root `package.json` plus `apps/docs/**`, but the landed app now references two more repo-root trees — `apps/docs/src/components/TokenTable.astro:5` imports `../../../../scripts/docs-data/token-map` (landed by ORI-AST-003), and the quickstart page's render-time source read opens `packages/docs-snippets/shared/quickstart-messages.ts` (the ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1 tutorial designation), so every scratch build dies `UNRESOLVED_IMPORT` (scripts absent) and then `ENOENT ... quickstart-messages.ts` (render-time). VERIFIED REPAIR: with exactly `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` mirrored into the scratch, the identical scratch `astro build` exits 0 with `Complete!` and emits `dist/docs/collection-reference/index.html`. # FIX-ORI-RN-003-3: Make driveWeb return from the seed web legs and the negative-control serve

## What this does

Makes `driveWeb` in `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/quickstart-web.ts` fulfill on the two seed web legs and on the negative-control serve. The function today calls `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded`, `click`, and `fill` with no action timeout. Playwright 1.63 defaults that timeout to `0`, which means wait forever. A `.catch` never runs if the promise never rejects.

The seed-visible, older-seed, marker, and cleared-input checks stay real observations. `driveWeb` must still return `seedVisible`, `olderSeedReached`, `markerVisible`, `inputCleared`, and `markerSubmitted` from the live page. A finite timeout is the backstop that makes the call return. It is not a license to mark those booleans true.

## Why

ORI-CONT-004 cycle 3 is blocked. Commit `6e98cf4ad9e00160cee84716cf2efedb1aa75ecc` is on branch `kb-run-sprint/sprint-05-orient-search/ORI-CONT-004` and is not an ancestor of main `44aa249187fd11e9054210d27fed0f51367dc988`. The worktree and main have the same `quickstart-web.ts` blob (`3e2299b7774d26dafef813a888fbfcd6d25dcfad`).

FLOW-DOCS-01-getting-started-engine-decision and FLOW-DOCS-01-theming-and-section-nav `run_flow` receipts exited 0 on 2026-09-28 at head `6e98cf4ad9e0`. FLOW-DOCS-02-quickstart-chat-screen did not. Its canonical receipt, in that worktree at `.tmp/sprint-05-orient-search/e2e-evidence/FLOW-DOCS-02-quickstart-chat-screen.json`, is still the 2026-09-26 file: `exit_code` 124, `artifact_fresh` false, `head` `a68c9a0eb19a94865ebe4b43bf739832bff8820e`.

Attempt 1 wrote the native seed screenshots and a uniwind web export, then listened on `127.0.0.1:8610`. That port is in `webSubmit`'s range (`8500` plus a random value under `400`), so `runAllLegs` had already returned. A second browser loaded that same page: HTTP 200, `Seed turn 24` visible, scroll to `Seed turn 01` in 206 ms. The in-process `driveWeb` call did not return. The note is `.kb-run-sprint/worktrees/sprint-05-orient-search/ORI-CONT-004/.tmp/ORI-CONT-004/cycle-3/red/flow3-attempt1-wedge.txt`. Attempt 2 stalled at `web_listen` for 482 seconds and was killed (`flow3-attempt2-heartbeat.txt`).

`quickstart-web.ts` is owned by completed ORI-RN-003. It is outside ORI-CONT-004 `writeAllowed`. This task depends only on ORI-RN-003. It does not revise ORI-CONT-004, the locked flow command, or `human-flows.json`.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts --entry runDriveWebReturnProof --mode red
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts --entry runDriveWebReturnProof
pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts -t driveWebActionTimeoutStaysFinite
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/quickstart-web.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts
```

`--mode red` runs before the timeout edit. It must record one real `driveWeb` call that is still pending at 180000 ms. The default command is GREEN: both seed legs and the three negative-control serves fulfill before the page closes. The vitest command is the source guard only. It must not launch Chromium or export.

## Scope

Own `driveWeb`'s action timeout, a bounded scroll helper only if the timed-out scroll leaves the older seed off screen, and the task-owned proof harness. No product source. No locked flow files. No ORI-CONT-004 charter.

AGENT: planner=react-native-reusables-planner | implementer=react-native-reusables-implementer | reviewer=react-native-reusables-reviewer

PROGRESS: 0/3 ACs; every TDD_STATE is none. All evidence paths are future outputs.

### OUTCOME

`driveWeb` fulfills on both seed web legs and on the baseline, disconnected, and restored negative-control serves. Each call records a real `WebLegResult` before the page closes. The seed legs show the newest seed, the older seed, one submitted marker, and a cleared composer. The disconnected callback still fails the marker check.

### CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS — Never

- Never change product source under `apps/`, `packages/`, or `scripts/`. An export failure is a blocker. Do not patch Uniwind, Metro, or `react-native-web` from this task.
- Never edit ORI-CONT-004's task file, `human-flows.json`, `gate-plan.json`, or `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/quickstart-chat-screen.spec.ts`. Do not run that locked flow as this task's gate.
- Never weaken the checks. These assignments stay the real observations: `seedVisible` from exact `Seed turn 24: Ready for your message.`, `olderSeedReached` from exact `olderSeed` `isVisible()`, `inputCleared` from the textarea value `=== ''`, `markerVisible` from exact marker `isVisible()`, and `markerSubmitted = markerVisible`. The outer catch must not set any of them true.
- Never prove this with a stubbed Playwright page, `page.setContent`, a mocked `Browser`, or an authored `WebLegResult`. A second client that can scroll the page does not count as `driveWeb` returning.
- Never leave an action timeout of `0`. `page.setDefaultTimeout(0)` and `timeout: 0` on `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded`, `click`, or `fill` are the hang.
- Never add a `fallow-ignore` comment. With no coverage file, Fallow CRAP is cyclomatic complexity squared plus complexity, and the gate fails at 30. Keep every new or edited function at cyclomatic complexity 4 or below. Put a scroll loop in its own helper.

### DONE WHEN

- [ ] AC-1 proves both seed web legs fulfill before the page closes, in under 180000 ms, with all five booleans true.
- [ ] AC-2 proves the three negative-control serves fulfill, and the disconnected callback returns `markerVisible` false.
- [ ] AC-3 proves the finite timeout, the unchanged check assignments, the static gates, and the write boundary.
- [ ] RED is a real pre-fix `driveWeb` call that is still pending at 180000 ms. If every pre-fix call settles, stop and report the booleans. Do not invent a hang.

### SPECIFICATION

One finite action timeout inside `driveWeb`, plus a task-owned harness that calls the real `exportWeb`, `serveExport`, `launchChromium`, and `driveWeb`. Immediately after `newPage()`, call `page.setDefaultTimeout(n)` with an integer `n` from 10000 to 30000 inclusive. `page.goto` keeps `timeout: 60_000`. `waitForFunction` keeps `timeout: 15_000`. Do not pass `timeout: 0`.

`fill` has no local catch today. A timeout rejection must hit the existing outer `try` so `driveWeb` fulfills with a `WebLegResult` instead of rejecting or staying pending. Do not delete that `try`.

If the finite timeout makes `olderSeedReached` false while the served document contains `Seed turn 01: Plan a weekend walk.`, replace the list and older `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` calls with a helper that scrolls the overflow div in at most 30 steps, then keep `older.isVisible()` as the boolean. Do not set that boolean from text presence alone. The same pattern already works in `crawlTurns` inside `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/quickstart-content.spec.ts` (read-only). Do not import that spec. Attempt 1 showed a second browser could reach `Seed turn 01` in 206 ms, so a returned result with `olderSeedReached` false is not GREEN.

`runWebLeg` and `webSubmit` in `quickstart-proof.test.ts` stay unchanged. They already require the real booleans. `PromptInput` clears the field after a resolved `onSubmit` even when the callback does not append a turn. Do not require `inputCleared` false on the disconnected serve. The marker check is what must fail there. Do not edit `prompt-input.tsx`.

### BOUNDARY CONTRACTS

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/quickstart-web.ts` (MODIFY): add `page.setDefaultTimeout(n)` and, only if required by the older-seed check, one bounded scroll helper. No other behavior change.
2. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts` (NEW): export `runDriveWebReturnProof`. CLI entry only when `process.argv[1]` is this file. `--mode red` and the default GREEN mode. Vitest exposes `driveWebActionTimeoutStaysFinite` and must not spawn a browser or `expo export`.
3. RED calls the real uniwind `prepareConsumer`, `exportWeb`, and `serveExport`, then `driveWeb`. If that baseline settles within 180000 ms, re-export the disconnected callback and call `driveWeb` again. Stop at the first call that is still pending at 180000 ms. Record `settled_before_close: false` and `elapsed_ms >= 180000` in `.tmp/FIX-ORI-RN-003-3/red.json`. Closing the browser after the watchdog fires is cleanup, not a voluntary return.
4. GREEN calls, in order: nativewind seed, uniwind baseline, uniwind disconnected, uniwind restored. Each must fulfill with `settled_before_close: true` and `elapsed_ms < 180000` while the page is still open. Seed legs and the baseline require all five booleans true. The disconnected call requires `markerVisible` false, `seedVisible` true, and `olderSeedReached` true. The restored call requires `markerVisible` true, `inputCleared` true, and the same sha256 as the original screen file. One changed callback only.
5. `prepareConsumer` rewrites `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-RN-001/{nativewind,uniwind}-install.txt`. Those refreshes are allowed side effects. Do not hand-edit them. Delete `NODE_ENV` before any pnpm, npx, or expo child, and use a short reaper-free `TMPDIR`.

### ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR

Only AC-1 is PRIMARY.

# Sprint 05: orient-search

**Status:** in_progress  
**Sequence:** 5  
**Timeline:** Phase 2

## Overview

Give a first-time integrator a complete orientation path: Introduction, one engine decision, registry-specific installation and CLI guidance, Theming and Dark mode, one seed-data Quickstart, and a handoff to a real AI SDK v7 example. Connect that content to persistent engine tabs, live theme values, built-site search, registry destinations, and useful missing-page recovery.

Absorb the smallest real prerequisites that make those paths executable: the published PromptInput import graph, both clean Expo consumers, a substantive ownership explanation, actual 404 recovery, the real example API and native composition, canonical registry hosting, and source-bound build and publication checks. This does not add another tutorial or a demonstrated use case. Sprint 06 may deepen the ownership tables; Sprint 11 may deepen resilience and accessibility; later delivery work may harden deployment and rollback.

The plan contains **36 tasks / 131 points**, compared with the roadmap sketch of approximately 12 items / 34–55 points: **76 points above its upper bound**. It retains 13 locked flows, 13 numbered gate steps, and four post-integration journey proofs. Estimates describe the approved prerequisite absorption rather than forcing the work into the sketch.

All implementation, functional RED, product verification, hosted acceptance, and deployment proof are future work. This document records a plan, not a passing gate or release.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** A stranger opening /docs/introduction over the built site's local preview can read in one pass that the library provides universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native, that it is distributed as a copy-paste registry, and that it is not an npm package.

**Entrypoint:** docs site local preview — built dist served by astro preview (http://localhost:4321) or the pnpm e2e:docs webServer; route /docs/introduction

**Before:** The source snapshot at the planned source SHA already contains Theming and shared layout, header, table, and tab controls. Introduction, Installation, CLI, Dark mode, Quickstart, the ownership-boundary route, and a custom 404 route are absent in that inspected snapshot. Existing Theming content still needs engine-correct claims and the real paired TokenTable. These are planning observations from the source, not current browser results. Each owner must observe the actual functional failure before implementation; the stale roadmap claim that all of these controls are absent is not a RED oracle.

**Success state:** A visitor reads useful, source-backed bodies instead of empty shells, chooses the correct engine once, follows literal registry commands, reads the same information without JavaScript, sees live theme changes without a flash, and reaches real content through keyboard search or missing-page recovery. The single Quickstart reaches a visible seed-data screen and then a separately verified real-provider example. # FIX-ORI-RN-004-4: Repair the native live proof after isolated iOS diagnosis

## What this does

Diagnoses and repairs the native proof that blocks the live half of Quickstart. Run the real iOS light-to-dark slice before a broad matrix, preserve the observed RED, and change only the native proof that evidence demonstrates is wrong. Then verify the inherited marker, streaming, active Stop, endpoint-loss/Retry, and provider-correlation contract on the slice and full caller.

## Why

ORI-CONT-004 cycle 4 is blocked by a file outside its ownership: `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example.maestro.yaml`. Its recorded candidate `21b2bf92673fa465aba3ba3dbc0ccd622ea24417` completed the seed prerequisite with six passing engine/platform combinations, but the separate Uniwind live driver recorded only two of three platforms passed. The iOS light appearance passed; dark failed to make the exact marker visible even though `hierarchy_has_marker` was true. Presence in an accessibility tree does not prove a visible marker.

The ORI-AI-002 wrapper also retained a `Stop generating` diagnostic from its intentional invalid-model rejection phase. The current caller records that child phase without requiring its completed flag to be true; a child diagnostic alone is not a second caller defect. Attribute it to phase/model and inspect the parent result and target validation before escalating. The confirmed failed live leg is the iOS dark marker check. Preserve the deliberate rejection phase and the valid-model active-Stop requirement; do not change either to evade a failure.

CONT's tip `e44dbabbaa28e31f70beeaaddd65aeb79ccb3962` contains an attempted YAML patch. It is unreviewed input, not approved code or passing proof. Leave that branch and its WIP intact. Start the repair from the orchestrator's assigned current trunk base, record differences from the failed candidate, and reproduce against that base before accepting a fix.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase ios --mode red --cycle cycle-1
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase ios --mode green --cycle cycle-1
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase full --mode green --cycle cycle-1
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase audit --cycle cycle-1
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts --case ORI-RN-004-AC-5-live-import-graph-compiler
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts
```

The task-owned entry point is a new thin supervisor and evidence checker over the existing real commands, not a replacement driver. Its `_test.ts` suffix is recognized by the shared flow validator and is excluded by the verified Vitest include `tests/**/*.test.ts`; no Vitest configuration change or heavyweight auto-discovered test is permitted. `--mode red` preserves the actual nonzero native failure; it does not manufacture a bug or report runtime success. Each retry uses a new cycle directory. The full command is forbidden until the isolated slice has a documented diagnosis and passes after the scoped repair.

## Scope

Own the existing YAML, narrowly necessary iOS-native sections of `support/live-example-proof.test.ts`, the small task-owned supervisor, and bounded evidence. The app, AI hook/backend, NativeWind driver, shared device adapter, caller orchestrator, and locked-flow files remain outside the edit boundary. A product/caller defect is a concrete block for its owner.

### OUTCOME

### CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS — Never

#### First diagnose the actual iOS slice

It must invoke the existing exported `runLiveExampleProof` or its existing CLI in a separate child using `platforms: ['ios']`/`--platforms ios`. The repair may navigate the real transcript or dismiss a real keyboard obstruction only when evidence shows that is the cause. Keep a final exact visible-marker assertion and prove the accepted user turn, not just an assistant echo. A coordinate tap is permitted only if the current device screenshot proves its actual target and it preserves accessibility assertions; do not copy `50%, 30%` or `visibilityPercentage: 40` from the unreviewed patch on faith. The native flow continues through the existing seed exchange, contextual follow-up, long response, active Stop, and endpoint-loss/Retry. Capture the request active at Stop and its incremental output before the tap. Its backend record must show abort before natural completion. A later completed record is not interchangeable with this request. Preserve the existing prompt/model/token configuration and prohibit injected delays or throttling changes.

For Retry, stop only the owned backend through its lifecycle handle, observe the real sanitized error and accessible control, restart that endpoint, and activate Retry on the retained turn. Require a new real request ID and exactly one retained user turn. Correlate records by run, request and appearance interval; do not reuse another leg's events. Inspect screenshots/recordings for visible text and reachable controls; hierarchy alone does not prove pixels.

The historical wrapper `Stop generating` diagnostic occurs in the intentional provider-reject phase. Current runEnginePhases records reject completed/status values and error records, then proceeds to the valid-model live phase; it does not treat the reject child's nonzero/partial outcome alone as caller failure. Inspect the parent manifest validation, concrete target rejection reasons, and live-leg status. An expected rejected-provider receipt is valid negative-control evidence, not automatically an AI-owner blocker. Only a demonstrated parent/caller contract failure outside native ownership is routed to the AI SDK owner, with exact phase/model/request evidence. Do not change the caller, skip rejection, restore the model early, or alter provider responses. Valid-model live phases must still prove active Stop.

#### Prove the existing full caller only after slice GREEN


Permit those real generated side effects only in this task's assigned worktree, then snapshot and hash them immediately under the task-owned immutable cycle directory. Other generated ORI-RN-005/ORI-AI-002 paths have the same side-effect-only rule. Do not copy into or overwrite CONT's worktree.

Require caller exit 0 and validate-only exit 0, all six target names, validation.ok true, and current source/run identities. Preserve the rejection/live/web-self phases and the inherited per-target criteria. Do not add a new aggregate or rerun pnpm test to diagnose a single native selector. Emit a supervisor heartbeat at least every 30 seconds. # Sprint 05: orient-search

**Status:** in_progress  
**Sequence:** 5  
**Timeline:** Phase 2

## Overview

Give a first-time integrator a complete orientation path: Introduction, one engine decision, registry-specific installation and CLI guidance, Theming and Dark mode, one seed-data Quickstart, and a handoff to a real AI SDK v7 example. Connect that content to persistent engine tabs, live theme values, built-site search, registry destinations, and useful missing-page recovery.

Absorb the smallest real prerequisites that make those paths executable: the published PromptInput import graph, both clean Expo consumers, a substantive ownership explanation, actual 404 recovery, the real example API and native composition, canonical registry hosting, and source-bound build and publication checks. This does not add another tutorial or a demonstrated use case. Sprint 06 may deepen the ownership tables; Sprint 11 may deepen resilience and accessibility; later delivery work may harden deployment and rollback.

The plan contains **36 tasks / 131 points**, compared with the roadmap sketch of approximately 12 items / 34–55 points: **76 points above its upper bound**. It retains 13 locked flows, 13 numbered gate steps, and four post-integration journey proofs. Estimates describe the approved prerequisite absorption rather than forcing the work into the sketch.

All implementation, functional RED, product verification, hosted acceptance, and deployment proof are future work. This document records a plan, not a passing gate or release.

## Human Testing Gate

**Gate:** A stranger opening /docs/introduction over the built site's local preview can read in one pass that the library provides universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native, that it is distributed as a copy-paste registry, and that it is not an npm package.

**Entrypoint:** docs site local preview — built dist served by astro preview (http://localhost:4321) or the pnpm e2e:docs webServer; route /docs/introduction

**Before:** The source snapshot at the planned source SHA already contains Theming and shared layout, header, table, and tab controls. Introduction, Installation, CLI, Dark mode, Quickstart, the ownership-boundary route, and a custom 404 route are absent in that inspected snapshot. Existing Theming content still needs engine-correct claims and the real paired TokenTable. These are planning observations from the source, not current browser results. Each owner must observe the actual functional failure before implementation; the stale roadmap claim that all of these controls are absent is not a RED oracle.

**Success state:** A visitor reads useful, source-backed bodies instead of empty shells, chooses the correct engine once, follows literal registry commands, reads the same information without JavaScript, sees live theme changes without a flash, and reaches real content through keyboard search or missing-page recovery. The single Quickstart reaches a visible seed-data screen and then a separately verified real-provider example. Acceptance also requires the discriminating build checks and fresh native, provider, public-registry, and hosted evidence specified below.

**Demonstrates:** UC-DOCS-01, UC-DOCS-02, UC-SHELL-02, UC-SHELL-01 (TokenTable half), UC-SHELL-03 (prose-persistence half)

**Fixed carryover:** UC-GEND-07 AC-2; TR-12 (full); CAP-DOCS-01 snippet/link build integration. Boundary, recovery, API, and publication work support this projection; they do not expand the demonstrated-use-case list.

# FIX-ORI-RN-003-3: Verify driveWeb returns and record the unreproduced hang

## What this does

Verifies the unchanged `driveWeb` against both real seed web exports and the real disconnected-callback control. Records an evidence-backed `not_reproduced_no_driver_change` disposition. The task does not claim a timeout defect was fixed.

## Why

The original charter required a call to remain pending for 180000 ms, but also required the implementer to stop if every baseline call settled. Two actual standalone cycles settled. Cycle 1 recorded baseline 1007 ms and disconnected 30838 ms. Cycle 2 recorded baseline 1005 ms and disconnected 30745 ms. Baselines had all five booleans true; disconnected calls had seedVisible, olderSeedReached, and inputCleared true, with markerVisible and markerSubmitted false. Both used unchanged driver SHA-256 `69e45cda55480d06b390637b48bd46fd97bad0ebee0af588c8175455439a3e33`.

The caller's ORI-RN-003 manifest records `completed: true`, `passed_legs: 6`, both web engines with all five booleans true, and the callback negative control passing at candidate `21b2bf92673fa465aba3ba3dbc0ccd622ea24417`. This contradicts the mandatory seed-path hang premise. It does not prove the whole locked flow passed.

The later ORI-AI-002 Uniwind manifest has `exit_code: 1`, and the iOS result fails the `Stop generating` assertion. The precise cause remains unproven. That live/native failure and fresh locked-flow verification remain with ORI-CONT-004 and its separately scoped dependencies; they are not repaired or waived here.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts --entry runDriveWebReturnProof --mode red
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts --entry runDriveWebReturnProof
pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts -t driveWebActionTimeoutStaysFinite
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/quickstart-web.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/drive-web-return-proof.test.ts
```

Every command is preserved and must execute. The historical spelling `--mode red` now means a real diagnostic baseline/disconnected run: it records whether a hang reproduces, without requiring or fabricating one. The default command verifies both engines and baseline/disconnected/restored behavior. The legacy `driveWebActionTimeoutStaysFinite` selector checks the diagnostic harness bound, unchanged driver, and retained observations; it does not require an unsupported driver timeout edit. These changes are explicit in the authorized amendment below.

## Scope

Use the existing task-owned proof harness and evidence paths. Preserve the current writeAllowed list. For this diagnostic disposition, `quickstart-web.ts` remains byte-for-byte unchanged. A newly reproduced defect is a blocker requiring a separate decision before any driver change. No product files, locked-flow files, or other task charters are owned here.

### OUTCOME

### CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS — Never

- Never edit product source under `apps/`, `packages/`, or `scripts/`; install/export failures are blockers.
- Never edit ORI-CONT-004, `human-flows.json`, `gate-plan.json`, `quickstart-chat-screen.spec.ts`, or the locked command. Do not run the locked flow as this task's gate.

# FIX-ORI-RN-004-4: Verify the native no-repair disposition and complete live proof

## What this does

Preserves two real iOS attempts that did not reproduce the reported marker failure. Verify their source binding, record a truthful no-repair disposition, and finish the unchanged six-target live caller with the inherited marker, streaming, active Stop, Retry, provider-correlation and cleanup requirements.

## Why

Checkpoint `f836d3665638efa16e877534ef17b5ecbdbfa182` contains the task supervisor and immutable evidence. Cycle 1 stopped during preflight. Cycles 2 and 3 each exercised unchanged iOS light and dark against real services on base `713eee79f70a15bba4c04dfa796151d69e1e6093`; each recorded zero actual native failures. The child exit 1 means the inherited one-platform `completed: false`, not a failed native observation. No YAML or native driver behavior was changed. The mandatory RED/repair prerequisite was disproven for that base and is removed by authorized ask `ask-wave28-revise-native-live-disposition`.

The final screenshots show the usable Retry/composer state. They do not independently show the complete marker; cycle-3 dark shows only its suffix. Earlier real Maestro exact `assertVisible` steps completed twice per appearance and provide temporal marker proof. Hierarchy presence and a final screenshot are not interchangeable with that evidence.

The original CONT candidate's dark-marker failure remains a historical observation, not a bug this task fixed. Its three YAML-only commits remain unreviewed. The intentional reject-phase `Stop generating` diagnostic alone is not a second caller defect: inspect the actual parent validation, rejected-model phase and valid-model outcomes. This disposition does not waive full caller proof or ORI-CONT-004's locked Quickstart flow.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase disposition --cycle cycle-4
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase full --mode green --cycle cycle-4
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts --phase audit --cycle cycle-4
pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts --case ORI-RN-004-AC-5-live-import-graph-compiler
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/native-live-repair-proof_test.ts
```

The existing checkpoint wrapper must receive the narrowly scoped disposition/full-gate/audit update described below before this sequence can run. `--phase disposition` is a new local evidence operation, not an existing supported flag or a new native driver. Cycle 4 is a new parent linked to the immutable older attempts. There is no mandatory extra isolated iOS run when the relevant native/product executable bytes are unchanged.

## Scope

Retain the existing task ID, owners, dependencies and file allowlists. Implement only the small task-wrapper changes needed to verify the disposition and continue existing real proof. Keep YAML and driver behavior unchanged in the no-repair path. If new evidence demonstrates an actual defect, stop with exact owner/path evidence for a scoped decision.

### OUTCOME

An independently reviewed, source-bound no-repair disposition and fresh passing six-target live caller. The native/product source remains unchanged. ORI-CONT-004 then resumes its own unchanged complete locked flow after safe integration of the reviewed native bytes.

### CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS — Never

- Never manufacture native RED, relabel passing attempts as failures, infer success from a partial-matrix exit, or claim the historical CONT failure is fixed.
- Never rewrite cycle-1/2/3 or `not-reproduced.json`, including their filenames, run IDs, execution SHA, screenshots and original claims. Add a new linked disposition to explain their meaning.

# FIX-ORI-RN-004-4: Verify the native no-repair disposition and complete live proof

## What this does

Preserves two real iOS attempts that did not reproduce the reported marker failure. Verify their source binding, record a truthful no-repair disposition, and finish the unchanged six-target live caller with the inherited marker, streaming, active Stop, Retry, provider-correlation and cleanup requirements.

## Why

Checkpoint `f836d3665638efa16e877534ef17b5ecbdbfa182` contains the task supervisor and immutable evidence. Cycle 1 stopped during preflight. Cycles 2 and 3 each exercised unchanged iOS light and dark against real services on base `713eee79f70a15bba4c04dfa796151d69e1e6093`; each recorded zero actual native failures. The child exit 1 means the inherited one-platform `completed: false`, not a failed native observation. No YAML or native driver behavior was changed. The mandatory RED/repair prerequisite was disproven for that base and is removed by authorized ask `ask-wave28-revise-native-live-disposition-refreshed`.

The final screenshots show the usable Retry/composer state. They do not independently show the complete marker; cycle-3 dark shows only its suffix. Earlier real Maestro exact `assertVisible` steps completed twice per appearance and provide temporal marker proof. Hierarchy presence and a final screenshot are not interchangeable with that evidence.

The original CONT candidate's dark-marker failure remains a historical observation, not a bug this task fixed. Its three YAML-only commits remain unreviewed. The intentional reject-phase `Stop generating` diagnostic alone is not a second caller defect: inspect the actual parent validation, rejected-model phase and valid-model outcomes. This disposition does not waive full caller proof or ORI-CONT-004's locked Quickstart flow.

# FIX-ORI-AI-001-1: Keep the worked example hook's regenerate payload itemIds unique

## What this does

Fixes the worked example's retry defect at its root. After owned-endpoint loss, the `useLiveChat` hook's clearError-then-regenerate path assembles an outgoing payload containing duplicated assistant message entries that carry repeated OpenAI itemIds in `providerMetadata`; the real OpenAI Responses endpoint rejects that payload and the server emits an error record with 0 deltas. The fix keeps every assistant provider-metadata itemId unique across the outgoing history before the transport serializes the request body.

## Why

ORI-RN-004's cycle-1 blocked report (checkpoint a86231aa) root-caused the iOS/Android retry-completion failure headlessly with the hook's exact SDK classes (`Chat` from @ai-sdk/react 4.0.92 + `DefaultChatTransport` from ai 7.0.89, throttle 50) and bisected it on the real backend: any payload variant leaving each itemId unique completes. Web passes only because its fresh-session path never regenerates with stale history. No pending task owns the hook file — ORI-RN-004's write-allowlist cannot reach `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts`, and ORI-AI-001 is completed — while the gate's locked steps already promise retry completion. The missing piece is this hook-side fix.

## How to verify

Run `pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-chat-regenerate-payload.test.ts` against the real owned backend and the official OpenAI Responses endpoint. The driver imports the real `Chat` + `DefaultChatTransport` classes from apps/example's installed packages, reproduces the endpoint-loss retry state through the owned backend lifecycle, captures the outgoing bodies and the server's sanitized records, and proves functional RED before the fix and GREEN after. Also run the preserved scoped compiler command below.

## Scope

Own the regenerate-payload fix in `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts`, one new scoped driver under `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/`, and bounded evidence under `.tmp/FIX-ORI-AI-001-1/`. Rendered retry acceptance on devices remains with ORI-RN-004; the server, the screen and the native drivers stay untouched.
